text: Every generation of our family has attended Sunday services at St. Michael's, going back to my great-grandparents. It is part of who we are. The idea that our children might choose not to continue that practice is deeply troubling. Some things are bigger than personal preference. When a tradition has been honored by your family for over a hundred years, walking away from it is not just a lifestyle choice. It is a rejection of everything your ancestors built and valued.
